population: 32 exact constructed development requests; two native-rule families plus guard, negative, unresolved, fallback, unsupported and budget controls; no external holdout
registration: Commit exact source/request/option hashes and this protocol before comparative runs. Keep failures and disclose corrections; do not change expected outcomes after seeing measurements.
semantics: Whole selected method admitted by the retained pure signed profile. G is a conjunction of qkf-target-v2 Boolean sign/popcount formulas. Width is all positive modular widths or one explicit fixed width. Source-local equality guards remain inside implications.
rules: structural proof of the least-bit projection for each supported word operation
source input sign/zero to target atoms
guard-only target abstraction and zero input
strategy: Enumerate the same bounded native candidates in fixed IR order, cache equal requests, then normalize source/target terms by these fixed directed facts and local identities. No learned planner, source residual builder or cross-goal lemma synthesis on this route.
routes: native facts then PR40 ground entailment
same native facts and cached preparation then ordinary unfiltered congruence closure with chronological proof
fallback: Explicit opt-in covered source construction followed by a NEW guard-aware target product; charge preceding failed native work and all fallback construction/checking. No unconditional legacy target verdict is used under G.
negative_policy: A model of finite E is only an unresolved source obligation. Refutation requires a concrete modular word satisfying G and the requested width. Empty G is independently checked and marked verified_empty_domain.
measurements: every native candidate attempt including failure/cache hit
full fallback calls and discovered objects
timing: Instrumented elapsed time is diagnostic only; no acceleration ranking, no causal contribution claim. Comparative routes are sequential, with identical registered cases and native rules.
replay: Fresh process in normal and optimized Python, producer/search imports forbidden. Positive ground proofs also replay with all legacy source-construction modules forbidden.
preservation: PR40 and older accepted files byte-identical except current workflow and additive test registry
